description: This file contains UI test cases for navigation flows in an Android app, using Jetpack Compose testing framework. It tests navigation behavior, UI element presence, and interactions within the app's UI, specifically for the 'Now in Android' sample app.

classes.name: NavigationTest
classes.description: UI test class for verifying navigation flows and UI behavior in the app.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection before each test.

methods.name: firstScreen_isForYou
methods.description: Verifies that the initial screen is the 'For You' tab.

methods.name: navigationBar_navigateToPreviouslySelectedTab_restoresContent
methods.description: Tests that navigating between tabs restores previous state.

methods.name: navigationBar_reselectTab_keepsState
methods.description: Tests that reselecting a tab keeps its state.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_doNotShowUpArrow
methods.description: Ensures top-level destinations do not show an up arrow.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showTopBarWithTitle
methods.description: Checks that the top bar displays the app name and correct titles.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showSettingsIcon
methods.description: Verifies the presence of the settings icon in top-level destinations.

methods.name: whenSettingsIconIsClicked_settingsDialogIsShown
methods.description: Tests that clicking the settings icon shows the settings dialog.

methods.name: whenSettingsDialogDismissed_previousScreenIsDisplayed
methods.description: Ensures that dismissing the settings dialog returns to the previous screen.

methods.name: homeDestination_back_quitsApp
methods.description: Tests that pressing back on home destination exits the app.

methods.name: navigationBar_backFromAnyDestination_returnsToForYou
methods.description: Verifies back navigation returns to the 'For You' tab.

methods.name: navigationBar_multipleBackStackInterests
methods.description: Test for multiple back stacks in interests tab (ignored).

methods.name: navigatingToTopicFromForYou_showsTopicDetails
methods.description: Tests navigation from the 'For You' feed to topic details.
